## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 190 captures during July 2025. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine screening and image capture service. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below. No changes to the site’s operating arrangements were reported during the month.

## Image quality

Of the 190 captures, 2 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.1. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for review. Staff did not report any new equipment faults this month. The site should continue routine checks of image capture equipment and maintain existing processes for identifying and managing images that cannot be graded.

## Grading

A total of 62 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This measure reflects the time taken for results to proceed through grading and provides an indication of the timeliness of the service during July 2025. The reported findings should be reviewed alongside local clinical follow-up arrangements and ongoing monitoring of image quality. Overall, the site has provided a clear monthly record of activity, image suitability, referable results, and grading timeliness.
